queries.cv25: SELECT fecha,tmh_cv025tot,tmh_cv025_tot,tmh_dia,tms_dia,humedad_pct,tag_utilizado,fuente,metodo,flag,observacion FROM reclamo.cv25_diario WHERE fecha BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY fecha
queries.graph: SELECT fecha,tms_cv25,tms_topografia,tms_preliminar,tms_publicado,diferencia_pct,flag_diferencia FROM reclamo.v_diferencia_cv25 WHERE fecha BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY fecha
queries.rendimiento: SELECT * FROM reclamo.v_rendimiento_rotopala WHERE fecha BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY fecha,rotopala_id
queries.preliminar: SELECT * FROM reclamo.v_preliminar_cv25 WHERE fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY fecha_operacion,modulo_id,rotopala_id
queries.preliminar_acumulado: SELECT * FROM reclamo.v_preliminar_cv25_con_acumulado WHERE fecha_operacion BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY fecha_operacion,modulo_id
queries.hours: SELECT fecha_turno,turno,rotopala_id,muestras_sobre_umbral,horas_por_muestra,horas_operacion,flag FROM reclamo.rotopala_horas_turno WHERE fecha_turno BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY fecha_turno,turno,rotopala_id
queries.other_equipment: SELECT fecha_operacional,turno,equipo_codigo,valor_final_resuelto,fuente_resuelta FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_contingencia_totalizador_resuelto_turno WHERE equipo_codigo IN ('CHANCADOR_CV006','PRINCIPAL_CV008','PRINCIPAL_CV108','SRR_CV001','SRR_CV002','SRR_CV003') AND fecha_operacional BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' ORDER BY equipo_codigo,fecha_operacional,turno
queries.downstream: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.referencing_id) referencing_schema,OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) referencing_name,o.type_desc,d.referenced_entity_name FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies d JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=d.referencing_id WHERE d.referenced_entity_name IN ('cv25_diario','v_cv25_diario','v_preliminar_cv25','v_preliminar_cv25_con_acumulado','v_diferencia_cv25','v_rendimiento_rotopala') ORDER BY d.referenced_entity_name,referencing_schema,referencing_name
queries.modified_objects: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) schema_name,o.name,o.modify_date,m.definition FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.name IN ('v_contingencia_cv025_diario_resuelto','sp_cargar_cv25_horas','v_cv25_diario','v_diferencia_cv25')
queries.downstream_definitions: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) schema_name,o.name,m.definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.name IN ('sp_calcular_reclamo_diario','v_reclamo_diario','v_reclamo_para_conciliados','v_preliminar_cv25','v_preliminar_cv25_con_acumulado','v_rendimiento_rotopala','sp_mantiene_datos_conciliados_emision_test')
queries.downstream_dependencies: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.referencing_id) referencing_schema,OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) referencing_name,d.referenced_schema_name,d.referenced_entity_name FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies d WHERE OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) IN ('sp_calcular_reclamo_diario','v_reclamo_diario','v_reclamo_para_conciliados','sp_mantiene_datos_conciliados_emision_test')
queries.cv25_constraints: SELECT name,definition FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('reclamo.cv25_diario') ORDER BY name
